analysis.headline: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns, then is reinstated, amid spy affair
analysis.summary: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO after admitting affairs, one with a woman US intelligence suspected of spying for China, amid congressional scrutiny, lawsuits and a stock drop. Nvidia's board said it would not reinstate him, then reversed course 11 days after his removal, following a public campaign and reported pressure from Trump.
